description: Road Crash Locations in SA is a dataset listed in the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue under the Road Safety Data (National Road Safety Hub) group, published by Department for Infrastructure and Transport, SA. Sites of road crashes in South Australia. Coverage is South Australia, 2008 to 2022; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as not stated, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2024-07-31. Files and pages listed: HTML (1 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. It can support road incident and emergency response analysis and capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
